feedback_driven.quote: XRepoSkill first contrasts successful and failed trajectories of the same agent on the same issue and derives candidate rules from where their execution paths diverge.

persists_across_tasks.quote: We learn skills from publicly released trajectories on the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard and evaluate them on SWE-bench Pro and DeepSWE using three backbone LLMs from different vendors

data.why_zh: 从成功/失败轨迹提取可迁移规则技能文件，冻结模型，跨仓库保留复用。
